slices.focus: Eric presents quarterly logs at the year-end operations meeting showing lower spoilage and steadier on-time fresh arrivals on pilot routes, earning a small implementation budget for dock thermometers, laminated route sheets, and limited refresher calls with pantry staff.
slices.summary: Evidence-based persuasion succeeds: leadership approves Eric's first implementation budget for practical cold-chain tools (thermometers, laminated sheets, refresher calls), validating that his pilot work has moved from provisional experiment toward recognized operating practice.
